# SCOPE

> SCOPE is a free-pilot platform in India for micro-internships and skill-based hiring. Students complete small, real tasks for startups, build verified proof of skill that startups can see. Startups post a task, review an anonymous top-3 shortlist, hold the bounty in escrow, and release payment in milestones after sign-off.

Key facts:
- Name: SCOPE (tagline: "Prove your skills. Show your work.")
- Audience: college students in India (any branch) and early-stage startups
- Status: free pilot. Wallet payments are simulated and no real money moves yet.
- Pricing: free for students. Startups post free tasks at no cost. Funded tasks carry an 8% service fee on top of the bounty. The full-time hiring fee is waived during the pilot.
- Currency: Indian rupees
- Privacy: applicants are anonymous to startups (year, branch, skills, proof points and match score only) until a startup picks them for a task.
- Payouts: bounty held in escrow and released in two milestones, 30% at kickoff and 70% at final delivery, after startup sign-off.
- Proof of skill: daily skill checks plus signed-off tasks produce credentials and skill proof points.
- Website: https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/

- [Home / open the app](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/): create an account as a student or startup.

- [For startups](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/startups/): how startups post tasks, shortlist, hire and pay.
- [How it works](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/how-it-works/): the full flow from task to payout.
- [Micro-internship guide](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/micro-internships/): what micro-internships are, whether they are paid, and how to find and do one.
- [Learn guides](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/learn/): first internship with no experience, portfolio projects, hiring interns, skill-based hiring, pricing micro-tasks, resumes.
- [FAQ](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/faq/): pricing, payments, privacy, matching and verification.
- [About](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/about/), [Privacy Policy](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/privacy/), [Terms](https://scope-prove-your-skills.netlify.app/terms/).
